title: SelectList responsiveness: calibrated historical before/after evidence

corpus.construction: Frozen Git-tracked relative paths repeated under unique copy directories. In-memory candidate snapshots, not a corresponding large physical file tree; fixed active-document context is fingerprinted.

methodology.aggregation: Every comparison aggregate, difference, coverage count, per-run statistic and full ordered-ID proof is preserved from its source summary; cohorts are not pooled or recomputed.
methodology.queryOccurrences: queryOccurrence is preserved. Initial s and later backspace-to-s observations are distinct, including cold-first-query versus cached reuse.
methodology.taskBoundaries: Both clipped maxTaskMs and boundary-preserving maxWholeTaskMs are retained; whole-task durations are the conservative task-cost measure for conclusions, not an alternative percentile calculation.
methodology.omissions: Raw phase arrays, timer/frame interval pairs, diagnostic sample rows and absolute local paths are omitted. Source summary hashes identify the full local evidence.

limitations: Frozen historical fuzzy sources explain the earlier report; this is not a comparison of all subsequent changes in the current checkout.
Shared desktop observations are gated and source-checked within each batch, not proof of complete machine isolation. Attempt histories and CPU preflight samples are retained.
Different cohorts intentionally differ in tracing, RPC instrumentation, full-result validation placement and requested input cadence. Driver/launcher fingerprints and cohort labels remain separate.
The first traced cohort retains RPC arguments in Jasmine spy histories and hashes results between query measurements. Later wrapper/replay cohorts avoid those sources of allocation pressure.
Legacy timer maxima include an unobserved final tail; zero callbacks can make the maximum equal the full asynchronous operation. Timer intervals are not CPU or keyboard latency.
Task intersections and GC/layout unions are wall-time evidence, not CPU time. Boundary-crossing tasks and gaps remain reflected in the preserved aggregate coverage fields.
Input events are attributed by submission timestamp and can arrive after the operation. Sparse samples and achieved producer cadence limit tail estimates; no eligible events is null, not zero delay.

LongTasks API visibility is callback-route-dependent. Its absence does not establish absence of blocking; positive controls and independent input, timer, frame and trace signals must be interpreted together.
Per-run and pooled statistics are both retained, including the original plain-run outlier; supplemental confirmations do not silently replace earlier observations.
The publication fix targets an existing synchronous result-index block in both historical implementations; diagnostic CPU samples establish the hotspot but are not ABBA performance measurements.

The current-code confirmation is untraced, so task/GC/layout trace statistics are unavailable there. Its input/frame/elapsed metrics and source identities must not be pooled with the isolated historical-delta trace cohort.

Some current-code phases still have higher elapsed or input-tail statistics, including Files backspace-to-se and Explorer clear-query input tails. Their full metrics and sparse probe counts are retained; no all-metrics-improved claim is made.

orderedResults.method: Strict count and SHA-256 equality of the provided full ordered-ID result vectors. Validation granularity is preserved as recorded; repeated timing query occurrences remain separate observations.

methodology.statistics: Pooled phase/event quantiles use linear interpolation; per-run summaries are also retained. Repeated identical queries remain separate observations.
methodology.tasks: maxTaskMs clips RunTask intersections to phase windows; maxWholeTaskMs retains boundary-crossing tasks. taskUnionMs is interval union wall time, not CPU time.
methodology.input: Input delays select recorded events by event.timestamp inside the inclusive phase window, including delivery after phase end. No recorded eligible event means null, not zero delay.
methodology.intervals: Frame and continuous timer pairs are selected by overlap with the phase. Full gaps and clipped overlap are retained with boundary flags; these intervals are not CPU durations.
methodology.longTasks: PerformanceObserver counts are supporting evidence; absence of entries alone does not establish absence of blocking. Explicit callerRoute labels are retained without guessing callback ownership.
methodology.missing: Absent probes and empty metric samples produce null statistics. Supported long-task reporting with no entries and measured zero GC/layout remain real zero observations.

instrumentation.evidence: Recorded cohort configuration; driver and launcher hashes identify the measured implementations. Requested input cadence is not achieved delivery cadence.
